about_the_game:
Ready for a world of cleverly designed puzzles that demand you think outside the box? Brain Test is a puzzle experience filled with unique and surprising brain teasers that challenge you to use your mind in unconventional ways. Now, this distinct experience arrives on the Steam platform with Brain Test All-Star: IQ Boost!

In this brand-new game, you'll test and push the limits of your intelligence with hundreds of original and tricky puzzles. Thanks to the all-new IQ scoring system, you can track your progress, continuously improve yourself, and showcase your brainpower to everyone on Steam!

Embark on mind-boggling adventures with characters like Agent Smith, Monster Hunter Joe, Uncle Bubba, and Doctor Worry. Each level has been specially designed to be more entertaining, more surprising, and even more challenging for your brain than the last! The Brain Test logic is now on Steam, and it's full of surprises at every turn!

The game comes with extra game modes on top of hundreds of main levels. Enjoy master levels that provide more challenging puzzles for the pro players. Keep yourself fresh with the daily puzzles.

Features:

Over 1000 original brain teaser puzzles waiting to be solved.

A detailed IQ scoring and progress tracking system.

New levels and fresh puzzles to be added continuously.

Tough challenges and daily special tasks that will make your brain sweat.

Fluid animations, vibrant graphics, and immersive sound effects.

Stress-free gameplay with a user-friendly hint and level skip system to help you when you're stuck.

Are you ready to test your brain on Steam?
